title: US startup Reflection AI is working with South Korea's Shinsegae Group to build a 250MW data center in South Korea, sources say in a several-billion-dollar deal (Amrith Ramkumar/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Amrith Ramkumar / Wall Street Journal: US startup Reflection AI is working with South Korea's Shinsegae Group to build a 250MW data center in South Korea, sources say in a several-billion-dollar deal — The Trump administration is using AI chips and models as a tool for diplomacy and boosting U.S. allies
